text: ∀x (River(x) → (∃y Source(y) ∧ FlowsFrom(x, y) ∧ (∃z Mountains(z) ∧ OftenIn(z)) ∧ ∃w VariousLandscapes(w) ∧ Through(x, w) ∧ ∃v LargerBodyOfWater(v) ∧ Reaches(x, v) ∧ (Ocean(v) ∨ Lake(v)))))) ::: A river flows from its source, often in the mountains, through various landscapes until it reaches a larger body of water, such as an ocean or lake.
